title: The Eclipse
description: The Eclipse's heaven half: bare End Stone, the Wellspring, pale Lumineshrooms under a teal aurora.

title: The Eclipse's hell half
description: Crimson stone under a crimson sky, petrified stalks and Flareblooms.

title: Nebula Fields
description: Violet Chorus Moss plains, and low gravity.

title: Ashen Barrens
description: The leviathan graveyard: pale stone and old bones.

title: Hollow Isles
description: The End's only forest: dim Nullwood on ring-shaped islands.

title: Drift Whale
description: A Drift Whale over the Ashen Barrens. Sing one a song and it's yours to ride.

title: Hushback
description: A clear-hided grazer of the Eclipse; hurt one and the herd blinks away.

title: Mirror Wretch
description: It throws familiar sounds from the void's edge to lure you over.

title: The Watcher
description: Only ever seen from the corner of your eye. Its eye is the Hourglass Nebula.

title: The Leviathan
description: In a Leviathan's skull: the reliquary, its pylons, and a floor open to the void.

title: Rift Maw
description: A colossal skull that wakes into a travel network.
